install.notes: Nothing to install for the fake backend. A live deployment (never run for this package) is the operator starting scout/scout_gazebo_sim/launch/scout_empty_world.launch under ROS 1 Melodic. This package does not launch ROS or Gazebo. That launch file's world_name default has no slash between $(find scout_gazebo_sim) and worlds/weston_robot_empty.world (scout_empty_world.launch:6). The velocity controllers named in scout_v2_control.yaml come from apt package ros-melodic-ros-controllers (scout/README.md:36), which is not in this clone. The driver binds /cmd_vel, the literal suffix at scout_skid_steer.cpp:22. The launch default robot_namespace is / (scout_empty_world.launch:3), so the C++ concatenation is the string //cmd_vel. This package does not cite a ROS name-cleaning function.
